public static fractalBrownianMotion(
        noise: BaseNoise,
        x: number,
        y: number = 0,
        z: number = 0,
        octaves: number = 4,
        lacunarity: number = 2.0,
        gain: number = 0.5
    ): number

Computes Fractal Brownian Motion (fBm) by layering multiple octaves of noise. Param: noise The base noise generator to use. Param: x X coordinate. Param: y Y coordinate (pass 0 for 1D noise). Param: z Z coordinate (pass 0 for 2D noise). Param: octaves Number of noise layers to stack. Higher = more detail. Default 4. Param: lacunarity Frequency multiplier per octave. Default 2.0. Param: gain Amplitude multiplier per octave (persistence). Default 0.5. Returns: Summed noise value, normalized approximately to [-1, 1]. PerlinNoise.grad2D: private grad2D(hash: number, x: number, y: number): number
Implementation: `const h = hash & 7; const u = h < 4 ? x : y; const v = h < 4 ? y : x; return ((h & 1) === 0 ? u : -u) + ((h & 2) === 0 ? v : -v);`.
PerlinNoise.grad3D: private grad3D(hash: number, x: number, y: number, z: number): number
Implementation: `const h = hash & 15; const u = h < 8 ? x : y; const v = h < 4 ? y : h === 12 || h === 14 ? x : z; return ((h & 1) === 0 ? u : -u) + ((h & 2) === 0 ? v : -v);`.
